<!-- pr-reviewer: 0b9fb11d7fe30d7f381e582751432d5ce65f6cfa -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge**

Independent review (not the author). The head already contains current main (c81cdd52), so the trial merge was a no-op.

**What looks good**
- The fix is small and in the right place: `crates/motion/src/machining2d/face.rs:202-207` starts the cursor at (0, 0, clearance) like the other mill generators and opens with a rapid to the entry. The X0 Y0 zero-length-move edge is handled explicitly (`face.rs:272-281`, no unwrap or indexing past the first move) and has its own pinning test.
- Golden check, as asked: I diffed every changed `.nc` golden against the base with the `N` line numbers stripped. In Fanuc, Haas, Mazak, Sinumerik and both `program_entry` pause_home goldens the only change is the added approach rapid (`G00/G0 X.. Y.. Z<clearance>`) before the plunge. In Heidenhain the first block changes from `G01 G40 G90 ... Z-2 F100` to `G00 G40 G90 ... Z+5` followed by the `G01` plunge, with the same values. The N-number renumbering in Sinumerik and Heidenhain is just the shift from one added line. The `.cl` goldens only gain `START 0 0 5000` plus the first `Rapid`, and the move count goes up by 1. Tormach replaces its #131 workaround (`G0 X0 Y0 / G0 Z0`) with `G0 X-5 Y5 / G0 X-5 Y5 Z5`, i.e. the real entry at clearance. Nothing else moved.
- Tests were updated to match, and the decision record is in `docs/decisions/690-face-approach.md` rather than `RECOMMENDED.md`. The body has a `Changelog:` line and ends `Fixes #690`. No `build.rs`, `.github`, scripts, dependency or `CHANGELOG.md` changes.

**Local results (merged with main, debug, macOS)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-motion` all suites | pass (machining2d 163, no failures) |
| app: golden_cl 23, conformance 6, fanuc_post 11, heidenhain_block_form 4, program_entry 9, regression_models 2, fixture_law_gaps 3, tormach_post 10 | pass |
| app: face_blend 3, face_origin 3, face_holes 2, posting 17, setup_mounts_post 6, per_op_files 9, cutting_data 6 | pass |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Not run: the rest of the app suites, because the app test build on main is currently broken by #686 (`lathe_thread_travel`), and `probe_tormach` fails on main (#695, fixed by #696). I did not run app-wide clippy.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
- The new approach rapid goes to the first row's start. If a fixture sits at the entry on the clearance plane, `fixture_law_gaps` now names move 0, which is the right behaviour.
- As the author notes, other generators that start their cursor at (0, 0, clearance) may share the X0 Y0 zero-length-move edge. A follow-up issue would be worthwhile.
- Not a defect: the Tormach script's old `G0 Z0` (top of travel) is gone from the golden. The approach is now at clearance Z5, which is the intended behaviour.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
